concept: Recovering agency after a setback, rather than falling into helplessness
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student experiences a realistic setback to something they initiated (a project fails, a plan falls through)
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides between giving up on agency entirely versus finding the next real move
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what the next real, small move would be

assessment.success_marker: student identifies a genuine next move rather than framing the setback as proof nothing can be done
